listings.description: A light trail running shoe with a 4 mm drop, a rock plate and a sticky rubber outsole. Available in US men's sizes 7 to 12.
A 2.5-layer waterproof shell that packs into its own pocket. Sage is a soft green. Regular fit.
150 gsm merino wool base layer. Machine wash cold. True to size, see the size chart.

policy.title: Refund policy
policy.body: Free returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unworn. Refunds go back to the original payment method. Exchanges are available on request by email.
